scenes.headline: Your agent thinks out loud.
scenes.support: the reasoning is already in the log
sentences: Your coding agent thinks in full sentences, and shows you none of them.
You hear almost none of it.

scenes.headline: It waits for the pause.
sentences: Reezyn waits for the pause, and keeps one thought.

scenes.headline: No model in the middle.
sentences: Adapter, cleaner, then Kokoro, on your Mac.

scenes.headline: Reply without the keyboard.
sentences: Say Reezyn, and it types the draft. It never sends it.

scenes.headline: The session comes with you.
sentences: Away from the desk, the session is on your phone.

scenes.headline: Local by construction.
sentences: No cloud, no telemetry, no upload.

scenes.headline: Then it just talks.
sentences: Free, open source, a minute to install.
